description: Single Battery Drill Driver: The BOSCH GSR 120 Li Drill Driver with a strong 12V battery, provides sufficient power for a variety of drilling, screwing, and fastening jobs. It functions in two modes: forward and reverse rotation for tightening and loosening screws easily. This adaptability allows you to work with different materials and applications effortlessly, making it a dependable tool for both DIY tasks and professional use. Compact Design & Lightweight Drill Driver: The compact design of this drill driver makes it possible to work in confined spaces and overhead without feeling burdened. With its lightweight and easy to handle construction, this drill driver promotes comfort even during prolonged use. No-Load Speed and Torque: The cordless drill driver offers a no-load speed of 0-400 RPM in 1st gear and 0-1500 RPM in 2nd gear, catering to various tasks. It can deliver 30 Nm of torque for hard joints and 14 Nm for soft joints, ensuring excellent and optimised performance in drilling and driving applications with a 2-Speed Planetary gearbox. Chuck Capacity: Its chuck can hold bits with a maximum diameter of 10 mm, providing flexibility for different applications. This guarantees that you can securely attach the appropriate bit for the job. Torque Settings: The cordless drill driver provides 20+1 torque settings providing versatility of various screwdriving and drilling applications.
